body:
## Changelog
### New Features
* 636cfe39490de851bcc6956f8a7fdc3892020971: feat: Add parser for CODEOWNER files (#1404) (@apnsngr)
### Bug Fixes
* 96fc461afcf81542eec87924f4fc70fbd172410c: fix(docs): unbreak Netlify build on the Noble image (#1433) (@boranx)
* 8345c40e21f3e6ab1159f4e15585b5f7d6aa32a7: fix: emit a single TAP plan across all files (#1435) (@behappymia)
### OPA Changes
* b254dd7828556d131c0bffd74ab6008358f87245: build(deps): bump github.com/open-policy-agent/opa from 1.20.2 to 1.21.0 (#1434) (@dependabot[bot])
### Other Changes
* a766df63c7f72642af16664b6b56b6361b70379a: build(deps): bump alpine from 3.24.1 to 3.24.2 (#1430) (@dependabot[bot])
* b4bcb74f527dc8d43cdd1db48d58f0e94624e1da: build(deps): bump docker/build-push-action from 7.3.0 to 7.4.0 (#1432) (@dependabot[bot])
* 6febea03f622afcd184732aa1c41edaa0f90222f: build(deps): bump github.com/magiconair/properties (#1431) (@dependabot[bot])
* e0275ea26dc8691e337a9f5e0d3fe99b4200af8c: chore: run goreleaser in parallel with docker builds (#1427) (@jalseth)
* 722d53f59d7bcc6bd14f11f85eb47a8a88cd7108: ci: Add SPDX formatted SBOM to the release workflow (#1428) (@jalseth)
* f1484a6ea54834cf9aca880e4674a5c9bc85c4e6: refactor(outputter): Standardize how totals are accumulated (#1429) (@jalseth)
